subject: Hosted API consumption sanity check — SignalHealth
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.inference>
To: Emma Zhao <emma@signalhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API consumption sanity check — SignalHealth

Thanks again for the demo this morning, Emma — appreciate the context about your bot workload and the weekly surge you see on Monday mornings. Quick recap + a couple of clarifying asks so we can land a neat price band for the hosted plan.

Top-level numbers (please confirm these are in the right ballpark):
- Estimated steady-state monthly tokens: 8M – 15M tokens
- Expected peak token throughput during surge windows: roughly 2,000 – 3,500 tokens/sec (peak windows ~10–20 minutes)
- Desired $/1M token target (your internal target): $400 – $700 per 1M tokens
- Contract preference: 6–12 month committed band if price is in-range

Notes and clarifying questions:
1) When you say "surge," is that 10–20 minutes of continuous peak (as above) or multiple shorter spikes across the hour? That affects batching and autoscaling assumptions.
2) Are embeddings a material part of the volume (e.g., nightly retrain / search reindexing)? If yes, approximate % of total tokens.
3) Any hard latency SLO for customer-facing flows during burst? (e.g., 95th < 500ms)

Proposed next steps from our side:
- If the ballpark numbers above look right, we’ll put together a two-option quote: 1) 6-month band with a slightly higher $/1M, 2) 12-month commit with a lower $/1M and a simple SLA.
- We’ll include a 72-hour soak test plan (no charge) to validate peak behavior at your concurrency shape.
- I’ll attach a simple commitment template for you to share with procurement (see attachments).

Will loop in Marissa for pricing mechanics and Karthik for the soak/ops plan.

Thanks,

--
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Emma Zhao <emma@signalhealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.inference>
Cc: SignalHealth Procurement <procurement@signalhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 17:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API consumption sanity check — SignalHealth

Thanks, Nikhil — that recap is helpful and close to what we discussed. A few clarifications from my side: 

- Steady-state: more like 10M tokens/mo average with expected growth to 12–14M by Q1 if adoption goes well.
- Peak: the Monday morning surge tends to be two 10–15 minute ramps separated by ~20 minutes; combined burst minutes ~30 per morning. Peaks hit ~3,000 tokens/sec for the longest stretches, shorter spikes can go to ~5,500 for 60–90s.
- Embeddings: yes — roughly 12% of total token volume currently (nightly reindexing + some feature-store generation).
- Latency: user-facing flows need 95th < 600ms; background workflows can tolerate higher.

Budget guidance: procurement wants a target in the $450–$650 per 1M tokens range to make the committed band work internally. If you can do $450 on a 12‑month commit at ~12M/mo, that’s a quick win.

We’ll review the commitment template and get procurement feedback tomorrow.

—Emma
Emma Zhao
Head of Product, SignalHealth
emma@signalhealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
To: SignalHealth Procurement <procurement@signalhealth.com>, Emma Zhao <emma@signalhealth.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Hosted API consumption sanity check — SignalHealth

Great — thanks for the detail, Emma. Based on what you’ve described, two quick pricing options we’ll put into a formal quote: 

Option A — 12-month committed band (recommended if procurement wants predictability):
- Baseline: 10–14M tokens/mo
- Price: $475 per 1M tokens
- Included: 3 scheduled soak tests (first one during onboarding), 99.9% uptime SLA for inference, dedicated support channel for escalation

Option B — 6-month flexible band:
- Baseline: 8–15M tokens/mo
- Price: $575 per 1M tokens
- Included: one soak test, standard support

Notes on the peak shape: Karthik, we should recommend the 72-hour soak target shape that mixes the two 10–15 minute ramps + short 60–90s spikes to validate autoscaler and KV cache hit behavior.

Procurement: we’ve attached a short commitment template to speed internal approval — it’s intentionally short to avoid legal delays. Happy to update if you want longer notice periods or a different payment cadence.

Next actions:
- Procurement to confirm which option (A or B) they prefer and if $475 on Option A is acceptable.
- Nikhil to schedule the soak plan once we get a verbal.

Cheers,

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sales Director | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.inference>
Cc: Emma Zhao <emma@signalhealth.com>, SignalHealth Procurement <procurement@signalhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Hosted API consumption sanity check — SignalHealth

Adding the ops sketch here so procurement understands what the soak will prove: 

- Soak plan: 72 hours across a test project; daily windows replicate Monday morning pattern (two 10–15 minute ramps + intermittent 60–90s spikes).
- Success criteria: 95th latency <= 600ms on user flows, no request-level errors above 0.1% during peak windows, KV cache hit >= 70% for repeated prefixes.
- Test artifacts we’ll hand over: traffic replay script, perf dashboard link, raw telemetry (token-level latency histogram), and a short ops runbook.

I’ll prepare a sample traffic CSV (attached) and drop the replay script into the shared Drive link in the quote doc. If procurement wants an exact concurrency target for capacity planning, use 3,500 tokens/sec as the conservative peak for autoscale provisioning.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
SRE & Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
